text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Miles really are my forte. I 
can run with total confidence!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Champion... You mean the Mile 
Championship?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I feel like I can do it now. I'll 
keep this momentum going and keep on 
winning!

—And so, aiming for the Mile Championship 
was decided!
